# lean-pkg palomar check

read-only, offline: every gap to Palomar's mechanical rules at one commit (module headers, toolchain floor, comparator configs, formalization.yaml, licence, repository); exit 0 ready / 1 gaps.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg palomar check [--rev REV] [--config PATH] [--rules FILE] [--repo DIR] [--json]
                       NAME
```

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--rev REV` | the commit to judge (default: the gate-bound commit, else HEAD) |
| `--config PATH` | judge only this comparator configuration (Palomar verifies the one a submission names); default: every configuration tracked at the commit |
| `--rules FILE` | a newer PalomarSubmission browser-preflight-policy.json (schema 1) downloaded by hand; default: the rules pinned at PalomarSubmission d4e41c1d5b0d (read 2026-10-16) |
| `--repo DIR` | judge the checkout DIR instead of the registered local_path (never saved) |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `palomar check NAME` | read-only and offline (no network, nothing written, no event): every gap between the package at one commit (`--rev REV`, else the gate-bound commit, else HEAD; git objects, never the working tree) and Palomar's mechanical rules, pinned at PalomarSubmission `d4e41c1d5b0d` (read 2026-10-16; `--rules FILE` takes a newer `browser-preflight-policy.json`): a `module` header in every tracked `.lean` file of the repository (exact list of the files without one), at most 10,000 lines, no symlinks; the toolchain floor v4.35.0-rc2; a Lake configuration, no submodules; each comparator configuration (`--config PATH`: only that one) with the required keys, no other keys (`judged_as`, `lean_pkg_scaffold` are refused), standard axioms, tracked module sources, a Challenge within 1,000 lines and 100 KiB; the headline configuration, when declared: the same checks, plus `comparator.headline_uncovered` (error) or `comparator.headline_unjudged` (warn) from the subset rule (JSON `headline` {config, source, judged, covered} or null); `formalization.yaml` tracked, v0.4-valid, no placeholders, Palomar's metadata minimum; one root licence file matching `license_spdx`; a GitHub repository, public, the commit pushed (these two `warn`). Each gap `{code, severity error\|warn, paths, detail, fix}`; verdict first and last; a `lean-toolchain` on lean-pkg's toolchain advisories list adds one `WARN: toolchain advisory ...` line per entry after the verdict, never a gap (JSON `toolchain_advisories[]`; [toolchain advisories](../receipts.md#checking-a-published-packages-receipts-receipt-check)); `--repo DIR` judges another checkout; exit 0 no `error` gap, 1 error gaps, 2 usage ([rules, source and date](../faq.md#palomar-readiness)) | `[--rev REV]` `[--config PATH]` `[--rules FILE]` `[--repo DIR]` |

A Challenge's imports beyond Mathlib's vocabulary (Init, Std, Lean, Mathlib, Batteries and the other libraries Mathlib brings in) are `warn` gaps, never errors ([#369](https://github.com/lean-pkg/lean-pkg/issues/369)): `challenge.statements_module` for the statements module `claims.yaml` declares (`statements_module`; "trusted by declaration, read it", with lean-pkg's refusal appended when the module fails its check) and `challenge.import` for any other module. A Challenge that imports Mathlib only gets neither ([A statements module for conditional claims](../comparator.md#a-statements-module-for-conditional-claims)).

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `palomar-check` (exit 1): `commit`, `commit_source`, `configs`, `counts`, `gaps`, `headline`, `lean_files`, `lean_toolchain`, `missing_module`, `name`, `not_checked`, `ok`, `project_path`, `ready`, `repo_override`, `rules`, `toolchain_advisories`

## Examples

List every gap between the package at the gate-bound commit (else HEAD) and Palomar's pinned mechanical rules, read-only and offline from git objects; exit 1 when any gap is an `error`.

```bash
lean-pkg palomar check my-proof
```

Sample output:

```text
my-proof: Palomar check at 9f18d4268b03: NOT READY — 5 gap(s): 3 error, 2 warn [HEAD]
  ✗  formalization.missing: formalization.yaml is not tracked in the project
        formalization.yaml
        fix: render it (`lean-pkg formalization my-proof --write`), fill the placeholders, commit
  ✗  license.spdx_unset: license_spdx is not recorded in the registry
        fix: lean-pkg update my-proof --license-spdx ID
  ...
  WARN  commit.not_pushed: commit 9f18d4268b03 is in no remote-tracking branch (local refs; nothing fetched)
        fix: push it; Palomar pins a commit of the public repository
rules: PalomarSubmission@d4e41c1d5b0d (committed 2026-10-05, read 2026-10-16); toolchain minimum v4.35.0-rc2; 3 .lean file(s), 0 without a module header
...
my-proof: Palomar check at 9f18d4268b03: NOT READY — 5 gap(s): 3 error, 2 warn
```

Judge HEAD and only the named comparator configuration, with each gap as JSON {code, severity, paths, detail, fix}.

```bash
lean-pkg palomar check my-proof --rev HEAD --config comparator.json --json
```
